mapper.sql: activity_enrollment.activity_id, activity_enrollment.user_id, activity_enrollment.sign_in_status, activity_enrollment.sign_out_status, activity_enrollment.create_time, activity_enrollment.update_time, activity_enrollment.deleted_flag
mapper.select: SELECT activity.id AS activity_id, activity.title AS activity_title, activity.position, activity_schedule.signin_start_time AS window_start_time, activity_schedule.signin_end_time AS window_end_time, activity_schedule.activity_start_time, activity_schedule.activity_end_time FROM activity_enrollment INNER JOIN activity ON activity.id = activity_enrollment.activity_id AND activity.deleted_flag = 0 INNER JOIN activity_schedule ON activity_schedule.activity_id = activity_enrollment.activity_id WHERE activity_enrollment.user_id = #{userId} AND activity_enrollment.deleted_flag = 0 AND activity_enrollment.sign_in_status = 0 AND activity_schedule.signin_start_time IS NOT NULL AND activity_schedule.signin_end_time IS NOT NULL AND NOW() >= activity_schedule.signin_start_time AND NOW() < activity_schedule.signin_end_time ORDER BY activity_schedule.signin_end_time ASC

SELECT activity.id AS activity_id, activity.title AS activity_title, activity.position, activity_schedule.signout_start_time AS window_start_time, activity_schedule.signout_end_time AS window_end_time, activity_schedule.activity_start_time, activity_schedule.activity_end_time FROM activity_enrollment INNER JOIN activity ON activity.id = activity_enrollment.activity_id AND activity.deleted_flag = 0 AND activity.need_sign_out = 1 INNER JOIN activity_schedule ON activity_schedule.activity_id = activity_enrollment.activity_id WHERE activity_enrollment.user_id = #{userId} AND activity_enrollment.deleted_flag = 0 AND activity_enrollment.sign_in_status = 1 AND activity_enrollment.sign_out_status = 0 AND activity_schedule.signout_start_time IS NOT NULL AND activity_schedule.signout_end_time IS NOT NULL AND NOW() >= activity_schedule.signout_start_time AND NOW() < activity_schedule.signout_end_time ORDER BY activity_schedule.signout_end_time ASC
mapper.update: update activity_enrollment set deleted_flag = #{deletedFlag} where activity_id = #{activityId}
